What Our Customers Are Saying

"Great selection, lowest prices for miles, and super nice staff. What more could you ask for? Always happy to visit this place."
David Racz Mission, BC
"The staff, knowledge and the sheer amount of stuff they carry is worth it alone. Not to mention great prices and lots of BC grown products."
Scott Logan Mission, BC
"The best dispensary in Mission! Excellent friendly staff always have the best suggestions, great inventory, and very clean. Only place to shop in my opinion."
Erika W Mission, BC
